shared_elements: human face with eyes, nose and mouth rendered frontally
headdress or elaborate element above the head
body shown with arms/shoulders below the head
vertically stacked composition of head above torso
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with a large head surmounted by an elaborate headdress or crest element, the body arranged vertically below, which is a broad but real correspondence. However, A is a low-relief figure covered in dense rectilinear ornament, geometric infill panels and flanking volute/scroll motifs on a flat plaque, while B is a plastically modelled figure with a simple naturalistic face and a separate toothed/comb-like crown, sharing no ornamental conventions or specific attributes.
